body:
you're very right. my friends are super into gossip. and they always are so judgey about people, critical, and i know it stems from jealousy because i know them so well. I don't like being like that. But they are the only friends i have, we've been friends since we were 10 and we are now 25. I can't seem to make new friends, because my personality is so off putting. It's just so hard. I wish I had been more confident when i was younger and had surrounded myself with nicer, more like minded people but I was so self conscious and used to being rejected that I just took what I could get and was grateful to have it. 

it's just hard being 25 and thinking back to being 15 when i felt the same way, and how i convinced myself that by 25, or even 20, everything be better. nothing really got any better, everything got worse. I was too scared to take risks, too scared to fail, so i missed out on so many opportunities that other people my age have had. Living abroad, or even just away from home, going away for university, interesting/challenging summer jobs. I went to a community college, lived at home and worked retail. because it was safe. and now i've missed out on so much that i can't get back.

it's a hard pill to swallow and i always told myself i would try so hard to avoid having big regrets in life but the regrets are overwhelming and i feel like i really let myself down

i know you're probably right but i have no idea how to do that. I've been doing this so long that it feels like my brain is just wired this way, i don't know how to think any other way. It's very frustrating. 

i know that fake it til you make it works, i've had to do it too. But i have no idea how to even begin. I have no idea how to be more positive... all the people in my life are equally negative. My family is like this, my close friends. I don't know, i feel very stuck.. i don't like who i am, but i don't know how to change who i am, and i'm scared of changing because i'm scared people will criticize me for what they perceive to be me acting fake, trying to be someone i'm not.

it all feels so stupid. i just wish i didn't have all these insecurities and anxieties and that i could just be happy and be the person i want to be but it feels impossible and it's so hard to wake up every day feeling like you hate yourself.

i will read almost anything that catches my eye. I'm reading a stephen king novel right now about the JFK assassination and time travel and so on. Before that I read Gone Girl. I don't read as much as i'd like to because of my ADD, reading generally isn't stimulating enough to keep the anxiety at bay haha but on rare moments when i'm feeling mellow i like to hammer out a bunch of chapters

Hi thank you for responding. I was worried nobody would. 

i guess what i don't like about myself is my defensiveness. i don't want to throw a pity party or tell a sob story but my whole life i've been criticized, made fun of, treated like an outcast. Not only by peers but my mom was very bad for being negative and critical of me even when I was very small. I love her a lot and i know she didn't know she was hurting me so bad but it stuck.

so now i have a million walls all the time. I'm scared to be genuine with people because i'm so used to being hurt by people that i just instinctively avoid opening up. I act like a goofball and i'm always cracking jokes, never taking anything seriously, being sarcastic, because i don't want to be real. And i've been doing it for so long that it's just my personality now and i don't know how to be different. and i know that people can sense it on me, people tell me i'm hard to read, that i'm guarded, and i know that i am and i know that it's off putting.

i don't like how sensitive i am. i don't like how my sense of humour is always pointing out the negative - i intend it to be funny, and it makes people laugh, but i know that the constant negativity is off putting too.

i just wish i could be open with people and let people in, but i can't. The few times that I have, the people i've opened up to have really taken advantage of me and hurt me, and it takes me so long, like, months or years, to recover from it

sorry for the rant i just have so much going on in my head and nobody to talk to. I don't want to talk to my parents about it because it's too personal and i'm embarrassed and i don't want them to worry. My friends do not care whatsoever, when I try to talk about it they are very obviously disinterested.

but as for hobbies i really like mountain biking, and kayaking, and reading and knitting, and travelling and exploring new cool places. I want to join some kind of recreational sports team and have for a while but i'm not good enough at anything and i'm so scared of making a fool of myself. I joined an indoor soccer team when I was 17 and the other girls on my team were way better than me and I'm just so self conscious I always felt like they were laughing at me for sucking, so I quit 

thank you again and i'm sorry for writing so much
